name: Nationalpark Camping Andrelwirt
beschreibung: The Nationalpark Camping Andrelwirt is located in Matrei in Osttirol, directly on the edge of the Nationalpark Hohe Tauern. The surroundings are dominated by the peaks of the Venediger- und Granatspitzgruppe. Numerous hiking trails and via ferrata routes start directly from the site. In winter, the ski areas Goldried and Kals-Matrei can be reached within a short time. The campsite has a sanitary building, electrical hookups, and a kiosk. Guests can expect a quiet, close-to-nature location along the Isel.
